def lcg_next(state: int) -> int:
    """Next state of the Park-Miller (minstd) generator, 48271 * state mod 2147483647."""
    pre state > 0 and state < 2147483647
    post out > 0 and out < 2147483647
    ex lcg_next(1) == 48271
    ex lcg_next(2) == 96542
    return (state * 48271) % 2147483647

def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """A permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed; xs is not modified."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 7) == []
    ex shuffled([5], 0) == [5]
    ex shuffled([1, 2, 3], 42) == shuffled([1, 2, 3], 42)
    m = 2147483647
    out = xs.copy()
    state = (seed % m + m) % m
    if state == 0:
        state = 1
    i = out.len() - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = lcg_next(state)
        j = state % (i + 1)
        tmp = out[i]
        out[i] = out[j]
        out[j] = tmp
        i -= 1
    return out
